name: Utah Puzzlers For Awareness 2020

venue.name: Parkview Building
venue.details: The competition is in the Gym

information: # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. # * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * No outside food and drink. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM. * The fees of this competition will be going to FOGS (Friends of Giant Steps), a non-profit organization that supports schooling programs for children that have Autism Spectrum Disorder.
